title: Broken dispatcherHook.pull() DoSes all user entrypoints
description: _syncBudget calls dispatcherHook.pull() unconditionally after cooldown. The hook is an owner-controlled mutable sibling with its own recipient config. If hook reverts, is misconfigured, or is re-pointed, every user entrypoint reverts. Users can only emergencyWithdraw.
remediation: Wrap dispatcherHook.pull() in try/catch on user paths; accrual still happens from _updatePool so users aren't blocked.
